entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, let's try asking around about[n]Futaba Sakura.

entries.speaker: Smoke Shop Owner
entries.en: Who? I have no idea who that is.

entries.speaker: Smoke Shop Owner
entries.en: Won't Sakura-san get mad if you go[n]prying into his business like this?

entries.speaker: Old Man
entries.en: Futaba... Futaba... I've heard that name[n]before...

entries.speaker: Old Man
entries.en: Ah, yes! That was the name of the teacher[n]I had a crush on back when I was in[n]elementary school!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This has nothing to do with us...

entries.speaker: Housewife
entries.en: Isn't Sakura-san single? I wouldn't[n]expect he has any children.

entries.speaker: Deli Worker
entries.en: By the way, I'd never expect you to eat[n]as much as you do.

entries.speaker: Deli Worker
entries.en: Well, whenever Boss[n]buys food, it's enough[n]to feed three people.

entries.speaker: Deli Worker
entries.en: You eat two full servings by yourself,[n]right? It makes me proud to hear that.

entries.speaker: Deli Worker
entries.en: ...Huh? I wonder if Boss eats it all[n]himself then...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm, it doesn't sound like anybody[n]knows about Futaba Sakura.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess we'll just have to go ask the chief[n]himself.
